title: Egg Fried Rice
iconSubject: A mound of egg fried rice with visible egg and spring onion in a simple bowl

steps.title: Beat the eggs
steps.action: Beat two eggs in a bowl until the yolks and whites combine.
steps.visual: A bowl of beaten golden eggs with a fork beside it

steps.title: Cook the eggs
steps.action: Scramble the eggs in the frying pan, then move them to one side.
steps.visual: Soft scrambled eggs on one side of a single frying pan

steps.title: Fry the rice
steps.action: Add cooked rice to the same pan and stir it with the eggs.
steps.visual: White rice and golden egg being stirred together in one frying pan

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.action: Add soy sauce and sliced spring onion, toss, and serve.
steps.visual: Finished fried rice with green spring onion in a bowl

title: Spaghetti with Tomato Meat Sauce
iconSubject: A nest of spaghetti topped with red tomato meat sauce and small pieces of celery

steps.title: Chop the vegetables
steps.action: Dice the onion and celery before heating the pan.
steps.visual: Separate small piles of chopped onion and celery on a board

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.action: Brown ground beef in a frying pan, breaking it into small pieces.
steps.visual: Ground beef browning in a frying pan with a spoon

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.action: Add onion, tomatoes, and celery to the beef and simmer.
steps.visual: Red tomato and beef sauce with visible celery pieces in a frying pan

steps.title: Cook and combine
steps.action: Boil the spaghetti in a pot, drain it, and toss it with the sauce.
steps.visual: Cooked spaghetti being tossed with red meat sauce

title: Simple Grilled Cheese
iconSubject: A golden grilled cheese sandwich cut in half with melted cheese visible

steps.title: Butter the bread
steps.action: Spread butter on the outside of two bread slices.
steps.visual: Two slices of bread with butter on their outer faces

steps.title: Add the cheese
steps.action: Place cheese between the bread slices, buttered sides facing out.
steps.visual: Cheese between two bread slices with butter on the outside

steps.title: Toast the first side
steps.action: Cook the sandwich in a frying pan until the underside is golden.
steps.visual: One sandwich toasting in a frying pan, lower bread turning golden

steps.title: Flip and serve
steps.action: Flip the sandwich, toast the other side, then cut it in half.
steps.visual: Golden sandwich halves with melted cheese between the bread
